paper: APPSC Group-II Services Main Examination (Notification No. 18/2016), Paper I: General Studies & Mental Ability, held 15-07-2017

questions.s: Who is the first Prime Minister of India to visit Israel?
questions.x: Narendra Modi's July 2017 visit made him the first serving Indian Prime Minister to visit Israel.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s: Which of the following persons is designated as global terrorist by US State Department at the time of recent visit of Prime Minister Narendra Modi to USA?
questions.x: During Modi's June 2017 US visit, the State Department designated Hizbul Mujahideen chief Syed Salahuddin, whose real name is Mohammad Yusuf Shah, a Specially Designated Global Terrorist.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s: What was the theme of the annual meeting of the World Economic Forum held in January, 2017 at Davos?
questions.x: The World Economic Forum's January 2017 Davos meeting ran on the theme 'Responsive and Responsible Leadership'.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s: What is the name of the place of recent border stand off between India and China?
questions.x: The 2017 India-China military stand-off took place at Doklam, a plateau near the India-Bhutan-China tri-junction.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s: Who is the present Director General of World Health Organization?
questions.x: Ethiopia's Dr Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus was elected WHO Director-General in May 2017, succeeding Margaret Chan.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s: Which carmaker company recently announced that it would make only electric or hybrid cars from 2019?
questions.x: In July 2017 Volvo announced that every car it launched from 2019 would be electric or hybrid.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s: The International Ayurveda Congress, 2017 was held at?
questions.x: APPSC's key gives London as the venue of the International Ayurveda Congress 2017.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s: World Meteorological Day is celebrated every year on?
questions.x: World Meteorological Day falls on 23 March, the day the WMO Convention came into force in 1950.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s: What was the theme of the New Delhi World Book Fair, 2017 held in January, 2017?
o: Manushi: Writings on and by Women
Renaissance of Civilizations - Understanding through exchange
Books: Doors opening for the future
questions.x: The New Delhi World Book Fair 2017 took 'Manushi', on writings on and by women, as its theme.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s: By what name Makar Sankranti festival is celebrated in Assam?
questions.x: In Assam the harvest festival at Makar Sankranti is called Magh Bihu (or Bhogali Bihu).
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s: What is the aim of Mission 41K of Indian Railways?
o: To run 41000 trains every day without failure
To save Rs 41,000 Cr in Energy costs in next decade
To upgrade 41000 kilometers of track to high speed track
To train 41000 employees every month to improve efficiency
questions.x: Mission 41K is an Indian Railways plan to cut its energy bill by about Rs 41,000 crore over the next ten years.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s: Which of the following States did not join the GST regime before 1st July, 2017?
questions.x: Jammu & Kashmir joined GST only after its own legislature passed the law on 8 July 2017, a week after the national rollout.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s: As part of Green initiative, Indian Navy installed solar power panels on board on?
questions.x: INS Sarvekshak, a hydrographic survey ship, was the first Indian Navy ship fitted with solar panels under the Navy's green initiative.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s: What is Bharat QR?
o: Mobile payment app to scan merchandise code by customer for instant transfer of money to merchant
Quantitative Restrictions imposed by India on import of certain goods
questions.x: Bharat QR is an interoperable QR-code payment system: a customer scans the merchant's code and pays straight from a bank account or card.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s: What is chicken’s neck of India?
o: Narrow corridor which links West Bengal with North East
Narrow mountain pass which links Sikkim with Tibet
Narrow strip of land between Ladakh and Tibet
questions.x: 'Chicken's neck' is the Siliguri Corridor, the narrow strip of land in West Bengal that links mainland India with the North-East.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s: What was the theme of Indian Seed Congress, 2017 held at Kolkata?
questions.x: APPSC's key gives 'Seed of Joy' as the theme of the Indian Seed Congress 2017 at Kolkata.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s: What is” Mission XI million”?
o: Mission of the Railways to train all its employees in etiquette
Government of India programme to bring 11 million families out of poverty by 2022
Government programme to train 11 million youth in skill development by 2019
Government outreach programme to associate atleast 11 million persons to popularize football before the FIFA Under - 17 World Cup 2017
questions.x: Mission XI Million was the government's school outreach programme to bring football to 11 million children ahead of the FIFA U-17 World Cup 2017 in India.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s: Who is the present Chairman of National Commission for Scheduled Tribes?
questions.x: Nand Kumar Sai became Chairman of the National Commission for Scheduled Tribes in 2017.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s: Who won the French Open 2017 in mixed doubles category?
questions.x: Rohan Bopanna and Canada's Gabriela Dabrowski won the 2017 French Open mixed doubles, Bopanna's first Grand Slam title.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s: Which country won the Azlan Shah Hockey Cup, 2017?
questions.x: Great Britain won the 2017 Sultan Azlan Shah Cup at Ipoh.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s: Who was the head of the Government of India panel constituted to review the FRBM Act?
questions.x: The committee set up in 2016 to review the FRBM Act was chaired by N K Singh.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s: What is GSTN?
o: A partnership providing IT infrastructure and services for GST
A non-profit, non-government company providing IT infrastructure and services for GST
A government company providing IT infrastructure and services for GST
A network owned by Ministry of Finance for GST services
questions.x: GSTN (Goods and Services Tax Network) was set up as a not-for-profit, non-government Section 8 company to run the IT backbone of GST.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s: Apart from Iron and Nickel, which of the following element is an important constituent of inner core of earth?
questions.x: The inner core is mostly iron and nickel, and APPSC's key names silicon as the important lighter element in it.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s: Which organization brokered the Indus Water Treaty between India and Pakistan?
questions.x: The World Bank brokered the 1960 Indus Waters Treaty and is also a signatory to it.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s: The theme of World Wetlands Day, 2017 celebrated in February, 2017 is?
questions.x: The theme of World Wetlands Day 2017 was 'Wetlands for Disaster Risk Reduction'.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s: From which Country power is imported by India?
questions.x: India imports hydroelectric power from Bhutan, from projects such as Chukha, Kurichhu and Tala.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s: Which is the basic building block/unit of all living things?
questions.x: The cell is the basic structural and functional unit of all living organisms.
questions.subject: Science & Technology

questions.s: Few decades ago, DDT was used to kill mosquitoes. Later, in the recent years, it became very difficult to kill mosquitoes using DDT. Which principle explains the immunity of mosquitoes from DDT?
questions.x: DDT killed the susceptible mosquitoes and left the naturally resistant ones to breed, so resistance spread. That is natural selection.
questions.subject: Science & Technology

questions.s: Which of the following is a viral disease?
questions.x: Herpes is caused by the herpes simplex virus. Malaria is protozoan, and typhoid and diphtheria are bacterial.
questions.subject: Science & Technology

questions.s: What is Hydroponics?
o: Growing plants in sand, gravel or liquid with mineral nutrients and without soil
Science of finding out underground water flows
Science of plants floating in water
questions.x: Hydroponics is growing plants without soil, in water or inert media such as sand or gravel, fed with mineral nutrient solutions.
questions.subject: Science & Technology

questions.s: Which of the following are generally formed in combustion of saturated hydrocarbons?
questions.x: Complete combustion of a saturated hydrocarbon (an alkane) gives carbon dioxide, water and heat. APPSC's final key corrected the answer to option 3.
questions.subject: Science & Technology

questions.s: Which of the following is used as a lubricant?
questions.x: Graphite's carbon layers slide easily over one another, which makes it a dry lubricant.
questions.subject: Science & Technology

questions.s: Why a bird standing on a high voltage cable does not get electric shock ?
o: The body of a bird is resistant to current flow
Current follows the least path through the electric cable
Feathers of the bird offer protection from electric shock
There is no potential difference between its legs
questions.x: Both of the bird's feet touch the same wire at almost the same potential, so there is no potential difference across its body and no current flows through it.
questions.subject: Science & Technology

questions.s: What is the angle of vision for a normal healthy individual?
questions.x: APPSC's key takes 60 degrees as the angle of vision of a normal healthy eye.
questions.subject: Science & Technology

questions.s: Which of the following is attracted to the North pole of a permanent magnet?
o: North pole of another permanent magnet
A piece of iron that is not a permanent magnet
questions.x: A magnet's north pole attracts unmagnetised iron, because the iron becomes an induced magnet. It repels another north pole.
questions.subject: Science & Technology

questions.s: Tooth decay occurs when pH of the mouth is?
questions.x: Tooth enamel starts to demineralise when mouth pH falls below about 5.5, the critical pH for decay.
questions.subject: Science & Technology

questions.s: Why is Sodium normally kept immersed in kerosene oil?
o: Kerosene oil is a good preservative
To prevent Sodium to absorb moisture in atmosphere
In open air Sodium explosively reacts with oxygen
questions.x: Sodium reacts vigorously with the oxygen and moisture in air and can catch fire, so it is stored under kerosene, which it does not react with.
questions.subject: Science & Technology

questions.s: A man posing as goldsmith went to a house and informed the lady of the house that he will polish her gold ornaments for a nominal amount. He dipped the ornaments given by her in a solution called royal water and they sparkled like new. After he left, the lady weighed the ornaments and found that they reduced in weight. What could be the solution?
questions.x: 'Royal water' is aqua regia, a 3:1 mix of concentrated hydrochloric and nitric acids. It dissolves gold, so the ornaments lost weight.
questions.subject: Science & Technology

questions.s: High Biological Oxygen Demand (BOD) indicates?
questions.x: A high BOD means a lot of organic matter is being broken down by microbes, which is a sign of heavy organic or microbial pollution.
questions.subject: Science & Technology

questions.s: Kigali Agreement modifies which of these previous multi lateral agreements
questions.x: The 2016 Kigali Amendment amended the Montreal Protocol to phase down HFCs.
questions.subject: Geography

questions.s: Which of the following has the least mangrove cover?
questions.x: Of these, Andhra Pradesh has the least mangrove cover. West Bengal (Sundarbans), Gujarat and the Andaman & Nicobar Islands have much more.
questions.subject: Geography

questions.s: Which is the first ‘carbon neutral’ international airport in Asia-Pacific?
questions.x: Delhi's Indira Gandhi International Airport became the first carbon-neutral airport in the Asia-Pacific region under the ACI Airport Carbon Accreditation.
questions.subject: Geography

questions.s: Which of these national parks of India is not recognized as ‘World Heritage Site’ by UNESCO
questions.x: Sundarbans, Keoladeo and Kaziranga national parks are UNESCO World Heritage Sites, but Gir is not.
questions.subject: Geography

questions.s: Who is the first Indian to receive the Luc Hoffman Award by International Union for the conservation of Nature and Natural Resources (IUCN)
questions.x: Dhrubajyoti Ghosh, known for his work on the East Kolkata Wetlands, was the first Indian to receive the IUCN's Luc Hoffmann Award (2016).
questions.subject: Geography

questions.s: In which country is the Svalbard Global Seed Vault located
questions.x: The Svalbard Global Seed Vault is on the Norwegian archipelago of Svalbard.
questions.subject: Geography

questions.s: Choose the correct Intended Nationally Determined Contributions (INDC) in carbon emissions under the Paris Climate Change Agreement set by India
questions.x: India's INDC pledged to cut the emissions intensity of its GDP by 33-35 per cent below 2005 levels by 2030.
questions.subject: Geography

questions.s: Which of the following is not an example of an Ecotone
questions.x: An ecotone is a transition zone between two ecosystems, such as a river bank, a mangrove or a marsh. A teak forest is a single uniform ecosystem.
questions.subject: Geography

questions.s: The presence of high coliform counts in water indicate
questions.x: Coliform bacteria live in the intestines of warm-blooded animals, so high coliform counts mean faecal (human or animal waste) contamination.
questions.subject: Geography

questions.s: Puga valley identified b y the Geological Survey of India has as the most promising field for geothermal power generation is located in the following region
questions.x: Puga Valley, the most promising geothermal field identified by the GSI, is in Ladakh.
questions.subject: Geography

questions.s: Coral Bleaching is associated with removal of
questions.x: Coral bleaching happens when stressed corals expel their symbiotic algae, the zooxanthellae, and lose their colour.
questions.subject: Geography

questions.s: Which one is not a major port on the West Coast ?
questions.x: Quilon (Kollam) is not one of India's major ports. Kochi, Mumbai and New Mangalore are.
questions.subject: Geography

questions.s: Which of these is an active volcano
questions.x: Barren Island in the Andamans is India's only active volcano. Narcondam is considered dormant.
questions.subject: Geography

questions.s: Which of these storms is land based
questions.x: Tornadoes form over land. Hurricanes, typhoons and willy-willies are tropical cyclones that form over oceans.
questions.subject: Geography

questions.s: Which organization regularly conducts mock exercises of disaster management in various parts of the Country?
questions.x: APPSC's key says the NDMA (National Disaster Management Authority) organises regular mock disaster-management exercises around the country.
questions.subject: Geography

questions.s: India’s first Earthquake early warning System is installed in
questions.x: India's first earthquake early warning system, developed by IIT Roorkee, was installed in Uttarakhand.
questions.subject: Geography

questions.s: What is the name of disaster Management exercise held at Visakhapatnam for preparedness in case of a super Cyclone
questions.x: 'Prakampana' was the disaster-management exercise held at Visakhapatnam to prepare for a super cyclone.
questions.subject: Geography

questions.s: Which of these is not a flood prevention and mitigation strategy?
questions.x: Depopulating flood plains, afforestation and decongesting river channels all reduce flood risk. Deindustrialisation along rivers is not a flood mitigation strategy.
questions.subject: Geography

questions.s: In a cyclone in northern hemisphere, air circulates swiftly inward in?
questions.x: Because of the Coriolis effect, winds in a northern-hemisphere cyclone spiral inward anticlockwise.
questions.subject: Geography

questions.s: How much percentage of the Geographical area of India is flood prone (choose nearest value out of the given below)?
questions.x: About 40 million hectares, roughly 12 per cent of India's geographical area, is flood prone.
questions.subject: Geography

questions.s: Which type of disaster is “Avalanche”?
questions.x: Avalanches are sometimes classed as hydrological and sometimes as hydro-geological disasters. APPSC's final key accepts both options 2 and 3.
questions.subject: Geography

questions.s: The first ever disaster management exercise on forest fires was held in April, 2017 at?
questions.x: The NDMA held the first mock exercise on forest fires in Uttarakhand in April 2017.
questions.subject: Geography

questions.s: In North India, heat waves normally occur in the following period?
questions.x: Heat waves in north India normally occur from March to June.
questions.subject: Geography

questions.s: What is the name of the operation in which the blockage due to snow landslide debris in a river in Kargil area is removed using explosives to prevent flash floods?
questions.x: Operation Phuktal was the 2015 operation in which explosives were used to clear a landslide blockage on the Phuktal river in the Kargil (Zanskar) area and prevent a flash flood.
questions.subject: Geography

questions.s: Which Rock system in India has most of the coal reserves
questions.x: About 98 per cent of India's coal reserves are in Gondwana rocks.
questions.subject: Geography

questions.s: Old alluvial soil on slightly elevated locations is called as
questions.x: Bhangar is the older alluvium on higher ground above flood level. Khadar is the newer alluvium on the flood plains.
questions.subject: Geography

questions.s: Largest Mica producing state in India
questions.x: APPSC's key names Andhra Pradesh, where the Nellore mica belt is, as the largest mica producer.
questions.subject: Geography

questions.s: The variety of Iron ore with the highest quality is
questions.x: APPSC's key treats hematite as the highest-quality iron ore, as it is the main high-grade ore mined in India, even though magnetite has a slightly higher iron content.
questions.subject: Geography

questions.s: A leaf of a tree adapted to a warm dry climate is:
questions.x: In warm, dry climates, small and thick (succulent or leathery) leaves reduce water loss through transpiration.
questions.subject: Geography

questions.s: The famous pass in Sikkim which is used by pilgrims going to Manasarovar till recently before China suspended tourist travel in the route?
questions.x: Nathu La in Sikkim opened in 2015 as a route for Kailash-Manasarovar pilgrims, and China suspended it during the 2017 stand-off.
questions.subject: Geography

questions.s: Which of these products does not have Geographical Indicator (GI) status
questions.x: Bobbili Veena, Banganapalle mangoes and Mangalagiri sarees have GI tags. Tapeswaram Kaja did not have one at the time.
questions.subject: Geography

questions.s: Which of these is not a tributary of River Godavari
questions.x: The Koyna is a tributary of the Krishna. The Pravara, Purna and Manjira (Manair) feed the Godavari.
questions.subject: Geography

questions.s: Select the correct Colour-Commodity option related to Rainbow Revolution (food area)
questions.x: In the 'rainbow revolution' colour scheme, the silver revolution stands for eggs and poultry.
questions.subject: Geography

questions.s: National Waterway 1 connects
questions.x: National Waterway 1 runs on the Ganga-Bhagirathi-Hooghly from Allahabad to Haldia.
questions.subject: Geography

questions.s: Which of these waterfalls is located in Andhra Pradesh
questions.x: Talakona waterfall is in the Seshachalam hills of Chittoor district, Andhra Pradesh.
questions.subject: Geography

questions.s: Which of these is not part of the Eastern Ghats
questions.x: The Satmala hills are in Maharashtra in the Deccan ranges, not in the Eastern Ghats.
questions.subject: Geography

questions.s: Panchmarhi Biosphere Reserve is located in
questions.x: Pachmarhi Biosphere Reserve is in the Satpura range of Madhya Pradesh.
questions.subject: Geography

questions.s: Biodiversity Hotspots are characterized on the basis of:
o: Endemic flowering plant and threat perception
questions.x: A biodiversity hotspot must have at least 1,500 endemic vascular plants and must have lost at least 70 per cent of its original habitat, so it combines endemism with threat.
questions.subject: Geography

questions.s: In which type of community, the number of species per unit area will be more
questions.x: Tropical rainforests have the highest number of species per unit area of any terrestrial community.
questions.subject: Geography

questions.s: The junction of North-South and East-West corridor highways is at
questions.x: The North-South and East-West corridors meet at Jhansi in Uttar Pradesh.
questions.subject: Geography

questions.s: As per Government specifications, what is the desirable range of pH value for drinking water in India?
questions.x: Under BIS standard IS 10500, the acceptable pH range for drinking water is 6.5 to 8.5.
questions.subject: Geography

questions.s: Which is the most exploited river in India in terms of abstraction of available water?
questions.x: APPSC's key names the Cauvery as the most exploited river, because most of its available water is already abstracted for use.
questions.subject: Geography

questions.s: Which of the following is the correct descending order of coffee producing states in India?
questions.x: Karnataka produces about 70 per cent of India's coffee, followed by Kerala and Tamil Nadu.
questions.subject: Geography

questions.s: Uranium deposits in India were first discovered at
questions.x: India's first uranium deposit was discovered at Jaduguda in present-day Jharkhand in 1951.
questions.subject: Geography

questions.s: In 1767, the British Parliament passed an act obtaining the East India Company to pay to the British Government per year a sum of
questions.x: The 1767 Act required the East India Company to pay the British Government £400,000 a year.
questions.subject: History

questions.s: After 1813, the British policy towards trade in India was?
questions.x: After the Charter Act of 1813 ended the Company's trade monopoly, British goods entered India almost duty-free while Indian goods faced high duties in Britain, a 'one-way free trade'.
questions.subject: History

questions.s: In which year East India company acquired the Diwani rights over Bengal?
questions.x: The Company got the Diwani of Bengal, Bihar and Orissa through the Treaty of Allahabad in 1765.
questions.subject: History

questions.s: In which of the following areas, Mahalwari Revenue settlement was introduced?
questions.x: The Mahalwari settlement (1822, Holt Mackenzie) was introduced in the North-Western Provinces, Punjab and parts of central India.
questions.subject: History

questions.s: In which of the following places Warren Hastings set up a Madarasa in 1781.
questions.x: Warren Hastings founded the Calcutta Madrasa in 1781 for the study of Islamic law and Arabic and Persian.
questions.subject: History

questions.s: Who among the following attacked Brahmanical orthodoxy and tried to reform Hinduism in Bombay?
questions.x: Bal Shastri Jambhekar, founder of the 'Darpan' (1832), attacked Brahmanical orthodoxy and pressed for reform of Hinduism in Bombay.
questions.subject: History

questions.s: Rahanumai Mazdayasan Sabha was started to reform?
questions.x: The Rahnumai Mazdayasnan Sabha (1851), founded by Naoroji Furdonji, Dadabhai Naoroji and others, worked to reform Parsi society.
questions.subject: History

questions.s: At which place in 1863 Mohammadan Literary Society was founded to encourage reform, modern Ideas and Western education in Muslims.
questions.x: Nawab Abdul Latif founded the Mohammedan Literary Society at Calcutta in 1863 to spread modern and Western education among Muslims.
questions.subject: History

questions.s: The Deccan Agriculturists Relief Act of 1879 provided protection for the peasants against the exploitation by the
questions.x: The Deccan Agriculturists' Relief Act 1879 followed the 1875 Deccan riots and protected peasants against moneylenders.
questions.subject: History

questions.s: ‘Bengal United is power. Bengal divided, will pull several different ways’. Who of the following made the statement?
questions.x: Home Secretary H. H. Risley wrote in 1904 that 'Bengal united is a power; Bengal divided will pull several different ways', which exposed the motive behind the partition.
questions.subject: History

questions.s: Identity below the cause of the dispute between mill owners and workers, which led to the mill workers strike in 1917 at Ahmedabad.
questions.x: The Ahmedabad mill dispute was over the withdrawal of the plague bonus. Gandhi intervened and went on a hunger strike in 1918.
questions.subject: History

questions.s: Who among the following wrote ‘The philosophy of the Bomb’
questions.x: Bhagwati Charan Vohra wrote 'The Philosophy of the Bomb' (1930) for the HSRA in reply to Gandhi's 'The Cult of the Bomb'.
questions.subject: History

questions.s: An American Journalist, Webb Miller gave a detailed account of the salt Satyagraha of which one of the places.
questions.x: American journalist Webb Miller's report of the police beating of satyagrahis at the Dharasana salt works in 1930 drew worldwide attention.
questions.subject: History

questions.s: Judicial Review is a symbol of
questions.x: APPSC's key links judicial review with federal government, where courts must keep the Union and the states within their constitutional limits.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: In India a person can be a Member of Cabinet without being a Member of Parliament for a maximum period of
questions.x: Under Article 75(5), a minister who is not a Member of Parliament must become one within six months or cease to be a minister.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: Whose previous consent is required under Article 224A of the Constitution to request a person who held the office of a judge of the same or any other High Court to sit and act as a judge of the High Court for that State ?
questions.x: Under Article 224A, the Chief Justice of a High Court may, with the previous consent of the President, request a retired High Court judge to sit and act as a judge.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: Which one of the following Parliamentary Committees in India acts as a ‘Watchdog’ on Departmental Expenditures and irregularities?
questions.x: The Public Accounts Committee examines the CAG's audit reports on government spending and is the 'watchdog' on expenditure and irregularities.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: The doctrine of ‘the Basic structure of the Constitution’ as a principle of Judicial Review
o: Accepts the theory of supremacy of Courts
Accepts the theory of supremacy of Legislature
Assumes the power of judging the Legislature on all matters
Is strictly in accord with the Principle of Procedure established by Law
questions.x: APPSC's key picks option 4. The basic structure doctrine limits Parliament's amending power without making courts supreme over the legislature on all matters, so options 1 to 3 overstate it.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: The 73rd Constitutional Amendment Act is not applicable to which of the States given below?
o: Mizoram, Nagaland and Jammu and Kashmir
questions.x: Part IX (the 73rd Amendment) did not apply to Nagaland, Mizoram and Meghalaya under Article 243M, nor then to Jammu & Kashmir, which had its own panchayat law.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: What would be the consequence if the State Governments fail to comply with the directions of the Central Government with regard to the exercise of their Administrative Power?
o: The President can send Centre Reserve Police Force for the implementation of directions.
The President can declare a Constitutional Emergency in the State and assume all the powers of the state governments.
The President can declare a National Emergency convert the Federal structure into a unitary one.
questions.x: Under Article 365, if a state fails to comply with Union directions, the President may hold that its constitutional machinery has failed and impose President's Rule under Article 356.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: The Supreme Court of India is different from its counterpart in the U. S. A
o: In its role as the guardian of the Constitution
In its role as the Supreme authority in the Judicial field in the Country
questions.x: The Indian Supreme Court has advisory jurisdiction under Article 143. The US Supreme Court does not give advisory opinions.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: Some of the fundamental Rights guaranteed in the Indian Constitution can be suspended only by
o: Any act passed by the Lok Sabha
The judicial decision of the Supreme Court.
questions.x: Fundamental Rights can be suspended only during a proclamation of National Emergency, under Articles 358 and 359.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: Where there is conflict between the Concurrent List and the State List
o: Matter will be referred to the speaker of Lok Sabha
Matter will be referred to the President
questions.x: Under Article 246, Parliament's power over the Concurrent List overrides the State List, so the Concurrent List prevails in a conflict.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: What is not true about Rights of Minorities?
o: Minority status is determined by the demography of the State.
They have right to establish their own Educational Institutions.
Minority Rights aim at ensuring equality
questions.x: Minority rights under Articles 29 and 30 are not absolute: the state may impose reasonable regulations, for example to keep educational standards.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: Justice P N Bhagwati was a pioneer of?
questions.x: Justice P N Bhagwati, with Justice Krishna Iyer, pioneered Public Interest Litigation in India.
questions.subject: Indian Constitution

questions.s: Who used the term “Hindu rate of growth” with reference to Indian economy and why?
o: Mahalanobis to describe the faster growth rate
Raj Krishna to describe the stagnant growth rate
Amartya Sen to describe the inequality in growth
V.K.R.V.Rao to describe the general growth rate
questions.x: Economist Raj Krishna coined 'Hindu rate of growth' for India's persistently low growth of about 3.5 per cent a year from the 1950s to the 1980s.
questions.subject: Indian & AP Economy

questions.s: Which one of the following was constituted to deal with taxation of agricultural wealth and income in India?
questions.x: The K N Raj Committee (1972) was set up to examine the taxation of agricultural wealth and income.
questions.subject: Indian & AP Economy

questions.s: Which committee suggested to establishment of an ‘Insurance Regulatory Authority’ in India?
questions.x: The Malhotra Committee (1993) on insurance reforms recommended an independent Insurance Regulatory Authority, which led to IRDA.
questions.subject: Indian & AP Economy

questions.s: In which city of Andhra Pradesh, The Raashtriya Vayoshree Yojana was launched on 1st April, 2017?
questions.x: The Rashtriya Vayoshri Yojana, which gives assistive devices to poor senior citizens, was launched at Nellore on 1 April 2017.
questions.subject: Indian & AP Economy

questions.s: Who fixes the benchmark policy rate (repo rate) in India
questions.x: Since the 2016 amendment to the RBI Act, the six-member Monetary Policy Committee fixes the repo rate.
questions.subject: Indian & AP Economy

questions.s: What is the target inflation rate notified by Government of India in August, 2016 for the period till 31st March, 2021?
questions.x: In August 2016 the government notified a CPI inflation target of 4 per cent (with a band of 2 to 6 per cent) up to 31 March 2021.
questions.subject: Indian & AP Economy

questions.s: What is the present installed nuclear power capacity in India?
questions.x: India's installed nuclear power capacity in 2017 was 6,780 MW.
questions.subject: Indian & AP Economy

questions.s: In which year, the construction of the Nagarjuna Sagar dam was completed?
questions.x: Nagarjuna Sagar dam on the Krishna was built between 1955 and 1967.

questions.s: Which state is the largest producer of Bt cotton in India
questions.x: APPSC's key names Gujarat as the largest producer of Bt cotton.

questions.s: The “Inclusive India initiative” launched by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment is aimed at?
o: Bringing people with intellectual and developmental disabilities into mainstream
Women empowerment to ensure equal opportunities for women
Brining Primitive Tribal Groups into national mainstream
Helping people of the third gender to obtain gainful employment
questions.x: The Inclusive India initiative of the National Trust aims to bring people with intellectual and developmental disabilities into the mainstream.

questions.s: Under the Bringing Green Revolution to Eastern India Scheme, improvement in productivity of which crop is achieved?
questions.x: Bringing Green Revolution to Eastern India (BGREI) mainly targets higher rice (paddy) productivity in the eastern states.

questions.s: How much percent of the total outstanding debt of DISCOMs is covered till date under the UDAY Scheme?
questions.x: APPSC's key says about 97 per cent of the outstanding DISCOM debt was covered under UDAY at the time.

questions.s: What is the share of Andhra Pradesh in Krishna waters as per the allocation of Krishna Water Tribunal?
questions.x: Of the 811 TMC of assured Krishna water given to the combined state by the Bachawat Tribunal, 512 TMC was apportioned to Andhra Pradesh and 299 TMC to Telangana.

questions.s: At how many places telemetry meters would be installed by the Krishna River Water Management Board to monitor the usage of water by both the State of AP and Telangana?
questions.x: APPSC's key says the Krishna River Management Board planned telemetry meters at 47 places to monitor water use by AP and Telangana.

questions.s: As per AP Vision 2029, what is the expected per capita income in Andhra Pradesh by 2029?
questions.x: AP Vision 2029 projected a per capita income of about Rs 9.61 lakh by 2029.

questions.s: What is the maximum amount of relief available to a farmer in AP on account of “Raithu Runa Mafi Scheme” implemented by Government of AP?
questions.x: The AP Rythu Runa Mafi scheme waived crop loans of up to Rs 1.5 lakh per farm family.

questions.s: In which city of Andhra Pradesh, Urdu University is recently started?
questions.x: Dr Abdul Haq Urdu University, AP's first Urdu university, was started at Kurnool.

questions.s: Which section of the AP Reorganization Act, 2014 permits continuance of officers in the same post in which they were working earlier, even after reorganization?
questions.x: Section 79 of the AP Reorganisation Act 2014 lets officers continue in the posts they held before the appointed day.

questions.s: Which section of the AP Reorganization Act, 2014 determines the manner of division of assets of Public Sector Undertakings?
questions.x: Section 53 of the AP Reorganisation Act 2014 governs how the assets and liabilities of state public sector undertakings are divided.
questions.subject: Indian & AP Economy

questions.s: How the treasury and bank balances are to be distributed between both the States as per the AP Reorganization Act, 2014?
o: Transfer of Cash from one treasury to other
Adjustment of credit balances of the two states in the books of RBI
Any convenient method to be followed
questions.x: Under the Act, the treasury and bank balances are divided by adjusting the two states' credit balances in the books of the Reserve Bank of India.
questions.subject: Indian & AP Economy

questions.s: Delimitation of the constituencies as proposed in the AP Reorganization Act, 2014 can be effected through?
o: Amendment of Article 170 of the Constitution
Notification by Central Government is enough
Passing of resolution by the respective assemblies
questions.x: APPSC's key says delimitation under the Act needs an amendment of Article 170, because Article 170(3) otherwise freezes readjustment of seats until after the first census after 2026.

questions.s: What is the amount determined by 14th Finance Commission to AP as grant under the State Disaster Response fund?
questions.x: The 14th Finance Commission fixed Andhra Pradesh's State Disaster Response Fund at Rs 2,492 crore for 2015-20.
